method: Bounded first-author independent model lexical proposals from actual checksum-verified English WordNet verb/adjective files + exact MCR Spanish mapping + independently inspected Spanish raw sense.25 exact pairs selected after scanning143 English definitions;118 deferred, not claimed fully linguistically adjudicated. No English finite rendering, form-generation authority, example sentence or native-human certification.

sourcePins.englishLicense: Princeton WordNet original license; see WordNet-LICENSE.txt
sourcePins.modifications: Exact MCR Spanish-lemma joins to Princeton WordNet 3.0 verb and adjective/satellite-adjective synsets from the pinned data.verb and data.adj files; adverb data.adv was checksum-verified and yielded no remaining baseline matches. Selected original model English lexical renderings are corroborated against exact pinned Spanish Wiktionary raw senses. No noun-only join claim, generated inflections, quotations or examples. English satellite-adjective source POS s is retained as actualWordNetPOS while its MCR synset join uses the normalized a suffix.

proposals.context: Adjective morphology, not the separate cannulating verb; source explicitly says cannula-shaped.

sourceEvidence.definition: constituting a tube; having hollow tubes (as for the passage of fluids)

glosses: Con forma de cánula.

proposals.context: Act jointly with others toward a common objective; lexical whole pronominal word, not an inflected ally rule.

sourceEvidence.definition: become an ally or associate, as by a treaty or marriage

glosses: Actuar con otros para un objetivo común.

proposals.context: Selected literal elevating/protruding reading, not animal rearing, standing up or rebellion borrowed from other synsets.

glosses: Sobresalir, elevarse sobre una superficie o plano.

sourceEvidence.definition: prepare oneself for a military confrontation

glosses: Prepararse para la guerra.

glosses: Proveerse de armas.

proposals.context: Grip/hold on to a contextual thing, not exploit a pretext or contend with another person.

glosses: Agarrarse de alguna cosa.

proposals.context: Intransitive abrupt stopping of an engine; not a person stalling someone or an aircraft aerodynamic stall.

glosses: Detenerse de modo brusco o inesperado un motor.

proposals.context: Colloquial selected error sense, not filtering through material or entering uninvited.

proposals.context: Selected meeting/party gatecrashing; not physical collision or computer failure.

glosses: Entrar en una reunión, fiesta o acto social sin pagar la entrada ni tener invitación.

proposals.context: Literal gradual acquisition of gray color. Also proposed in the separate40-frame draft; do not double-count or automatically add inflection authority.

glosses: Ir adquiriendo algo un tono gris.

english: to use clues or ideas as a guide
proposals.context: Clues/signals/ideas/motivation guide a decision; not causatively guide another person.

glosses: Dejarse llevar, tomar una decisión, por indicios, señales, ideas o motivaciones.

proposals.context: Liquid becomes ice; inchoative, never a person causing something else to freeze.

glosses: Solidificarse o volverse hielo (un líquido) por la acción del frío.

sourceEvidence.definition: change from a liquid to a solid when cold

glosses: Coagularse o solidificarse algo que se había licuado, como la grasa, los metales, etc., por faltarle el calor necesario para mantenerse en el estado líquido.

proposals.context: Selected physical firm bond, not every moral alliance or regional telephone/castigation sense.

glosses: Adquirir, crear o contraer un vínculo firme con otro(s), que puede ser físico o moral.

english: to measure oneself against others in competition

sourceEvidence.definition: compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others

glosses: Establecer la propia fuerza o intensidad, al compararlo o enfrentarlo con otro elemento o con alguna circunstancia.

glosses: Burlarse de alguien.

glosses: Burlarse de alguien.

proposals.context: Be angry or offended at something; not injecting drugs, wine souring or an animal being in heat.

glosses: Enojarse u ofenderse de alguna cosa.

proposals.context: Inchoative wear, not a person actively scraping another object; actual cause/abrasion sense comes from the English synset.

glosses: Desgastarse.

proposals.context: Back down from a difficult/frightening situation at the last moment; not spontaneous splitting of a material.

glosses: Acobardarse, desistirse de alguna situación díficil o temerosa en el último momento.

proposals.context: A river loses its water; selected inchoative sense, not wiping a person with an invented towel.

glosses: Dicho de un río: quedarse sin agua.

proposals.context: Plant loses greenness/vigor, matching freshness/vitality loss; not total mummification or human weight loss.

glosses: Dicho de una planta: perder su verdor, vigor o lozanía.

limits: Independent Spec review required for exact English wording, source identity and contexts before production.
Full Spanish words ending in -SE are lexical entries here. This does not authorize stripping SE, generating any finite form, or applying direct-object/reflexive clitic templates.
Explicit source part of speech is retained separately from English synset POS, including satellite adjectives; no POS inferred from English alone.
Selected English may narrow a broad synset using the explicit Spanish context; it does not claim exhaustive senses or examples.
No corpus download performed by this reviewer; only provided verified local files used.
GRISEAR is already pending via the40-frame first-author draft; consolidate providers and do not double-count.
Do not surface unreviewed grammatical gender inventory as certified; preserve source regional/colloquial/vulgar/technical labels and coreference/role context.
